title: Throttle Sensor Low Error
detail_of_failure: Low voltage is sensed in the fuel dial circuit.
controller_action: • If an abnormality occurs while the starting switch is set in the ON position, the controller fixes the voltage at the value before detection of the abnormality to continue the operation. • If the starting switch is turned to the ON position after the abnormality occurs, the controller runs the engine at the value of 100%.
machine_effect: Engine speed cannot be controlled with the fuel dial.
related_information: • Signal voltage of the fuel dial can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 03000) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “RELATED INFORMA- TION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.

steps.cause: Defective throttle sensor power supply system
steps.procedure: If failure code [CA2186] is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first.
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector P20. Connect a T-adapter to the male side.

steps.cause: Open or short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector CE02. Connect a T-adapter to the female side.

steps.cause: Open circuit in wiring harness (wire breakage or defective contact of connector)
steps.procedure: If no failure is found by check on cause 4, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CE02 and P20, and connect a T-adapter to each female side.
If no failure is found by check on cause 4, this check is not required. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CE02 and P20, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between CE02 (female) (9) and (23), or between P20 (female) (2) and (3)

steps.cause: Ground fault in wiring harness (contact with ground circuit)
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors CE02 and P20, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ground and CE02 (female) (9) or P20 (female) (2)

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.) 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector CE02. 3. Starting switch: ON 4. Operate the fuel control dial to do the troubleshooting.
